title: FileMaker file coupling
description: Module-coupling matrix between the FileMaker files of the solution: cross-file ObjectLinks aggregated by source file × target file × link role, plus the declared external FileMaker data sources and inter-file access authorizations. Answers "which module depends on which?" as a tabular audit view complementing the Graph Atlas.
author: fm-lab

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter) — matches the file as source or target of a coupling.

params.name: source_file
params.description: Restricts the detail list to couplings originating in this file. 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: target_file
params.description: Restricts the detail list to couplings targeting this file. 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: link_role
params.description: Restricts the detail list to a specific link role (e.g. displays_field, calls_script). 'All' (or empty) lifts the filter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows returned by the detail / matrix lists.
